invariants.statement: A proposal, plan, assistant claim, or generated file must not be labelled realised or verified without evidence.
Presence in ChatGPT does not prove presence on SandY, ARAGORN, Hermes, n8n, or another SI.
An explicit user correction supersedes the corrected prior state within its scope.
Search for an existing admitted capability before proposing a new component for the same need.
Do not claim completion until the required artifact/function/test evidence exists.
